title: fix(studio): close the three journey dead-ends from UX review
body:
Implements the P1 items from the browser UX review of the merged journey (Home cover → /studio → app).

## Fixes

1. **Navigation dead ends**: the standalone `/studio` landing gains a slim frame with an ObjectOS wordmark → Home; the builder top bar gains a **Home** button. Previously both were browser-back-only.
2. **Fresh-package empty state**: an empty writable package showed an endless 加载中… and an unhelpful 「选择一个对象」. Now: rail reads 还没有对象, the object creator **auto-opens**, and the main pane explains the first act (从第一个对象开始 + what objects are).
3. **创建应用 on-ramp**: a package with no app had no path to a published front-end. The bridge slot now offers **创建应用** (draft `app` via a name/identifier popover) → 「应用「…」待发布」 → flips to **打开应用** after the package publish.

## Browser-verified (fresh backend :3013)

Landing frame + Home button ✓ · new package 库存中心: empty states + auto-opened creator ✓ · 创建应用 库存中心/inventory_app → draft (变更·1) → 发布 → **打开应用** targets `/apps/inventory_app` ✓ · Home icon returns to /home ✓. `type-check`: 0 errors.
